g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-404 Wrap labeler for round containers (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: orange = parts added in that step; ghosted = parts still to come
H1 x4 M6 8 N·m; H2 x6 M5 5 N·m; H3 x2 M8 15 N·m; H10 x2 M5 3 N·m
plates parallel 0.05 over 320 (bore R holes in line, ITP T3); base flat on the bench
H4 x4 M5 4 N·m (slots: tension); H6 x2 per pulley 1.5 N·m + Loctite 243; H7 rings
belt 1 deflects 3 at 10 N mid-span; rollers turn together, run-out ≤ 0.05 (T6)
H5 x6 M5 4 N·m (slots: belt 2); H6; H12 x6 M4 1.5 N·m
liner surface speed = roller surface speed (mark test, T9); pinch closes on the knurl
unwind turns with a light even drag (felt); rewind slips on the O-ring belt when held
tip 15 behind the container top, 1 above (T7); fork straddles the web edge, teach on liner
H3 x2 M8 15 N·m; H14 x2 M5 2 N·m
arm drops onto the container under its own weight; B2 switches with the arm down on both containers (T12)
wiring per E01, < 0.1 Ω PE (T13); program P1-404-FW-01 loaded
label lands square on the container with ≤ 1 overlap error (T15-T17)
1. Base 101 on the bench TBL-2; side plates 102 (-x) and 103 (+x) on the base with 3 screws each from below; tie rod 104 between them; end fence 105 at S or J.
2. Bearings 6001-2RS in the R holes of both plates; drive rollers P1-425 (key flat at -x) with 30T pulleys and rings; motor P1-426 on the -x inner face, 15T pulley; belt 1 375-3M round A, motor, B.

3. Housings 201 into H1 (liner drive) and H2 (rewind) with bearings; liner drive 202 with the 18T pulley; belt 2 261-3M from the second 30T on roller B; pinch lever 203 with its spring; guard 204 on standoffs.
4. Unwind spindle 301 (3 screws), hub 302 with flange, collar 303; brake leaf 304 with felt; rewind shaft 305 in housing H2 with hub 302 and O-ring pulleys 306 + PU belt; guide roller 307.
5. Peel bracket 402 at PS (shaker) or PJ (jar) holes; peel plate 401 on the bracket arm; gap sensor P1-427 on the plate edge over the window.

6. Pivot shaft 403 between the plates; idler arms 404 on it with nylon washers; idler shaft 405 with the idler roller P1-455; knob on the +x arm; sensor bracket 406 and start sensor P1-457 in the 103 plate.
7. Controls box P1-456 on the +x end of the base (2 screws inside the floor); G1 and terminals on the back wall, A1 on the floor; cables W0-W4 per E01.
8. Label roll on the unwind hub (labels out, wound out); thread up per the card; liner end into the rewind hub slot, 2 turns; FEED to the first gap. Lay the first container on the rollers.
THREAD-UP (2:5), SEEN FROM +X: LABEL WEB DASHED RED, LINER DASH-DOT

g.text: 4 ROUND THE PEEL TIP, LINER BACK UNDER

svg.text: 1. Thread-up: unwind (labels outward, coming off the top) → over the guide roller 307 → under the gap fork → over the peel plate to the tip → round the tip, liner back under the plate → between the liner drive 202 and the pinch 203 (lift the lever) → rewind hub
302. Cut the first labels off the liner for 300 mm.

2. Changeover shaker ↔ jar (about 3 min, power off): fence 105 to its S or J holes (2 screws); peel bracket 402 to PS or PJ (2 screws); S2 to S or J; change the label roll; FEED to the first gap. Nothing else changes: the rollers and the idler arm suit both

3. Each cycle: lay the container on the rollers against the fence, lower the arm with the knob; the label runs (1.8 s jar) and stops at the next gap; lift the arm, take the container. About 14 per minute.
4. Cleaning: wipe down only; no product contact (the container is closed and capped). Keep adhesive off the rollers: clean with IPA on a cloth, never solvent on the urethane.
5. Care: belts every 6 months (tension, wear); felt pad yearly; replace the urethane roller covers when the Ø is down 0.3 (labels start to skew).

pulleys (2 each) on the rollers, motor, liner drive
roller shafts outside the bearings, liner drive and rewind shafts
Socket cap screw M4 x 10 A2
unwind spindle flange to the -x plate
Socket cap screw M5 x 10 A2
peel bracket 402 at S or J (2), peel plate to bracket (2)
Socket cap screw M5 x 12 A2
end fence 105 to the base at S or J
guide roller shaft 307 and pinch pivot through the -x plate
Button head screw M4 x 8 A2
belt guard 204 to the -x plate on 3 standoffs
Socket cap screw M6 x 16 A2 + bonded sealing washer
enclosure bottom wall to the base at x 255, y ±60 (inside the box)

idler shaft in the arms (2), rewind hub (1), collars (1)
